name: Should I hire a specialty drywall contractor or a general remodeling contractor?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a specialty drywall contractor or a general remodeling contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a dedicated drywall company can work well for large-scale new builds, but a full-scope remodeling contractor is often the better choice when wall damage intersects other trades. Drywall failures frequently involve underlying plumbing leaks, displaced electrical outlets, damaged baseboards, or nearby tile work. Choosing an owner-operated remodeler like HH Remodeling LLC gives you a single point of contact who can adjust custom framing, replace baseboards, coordinate licensed mechanical trades, and apply matching interior paint alongside the drywall work. This eliminates scheduling delays and avoids having multiple independent crews pointing fingers over unfinished perimeter details.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general remodeling contractor is ideal when damage involves framing, baseboards, painting, or plumbing coordination; dedicated drywallers fit new bare-frame builds.
